Html

The loose, elm/html-like producer layer: one open-rowed constructor per element, each owning `Ir.node "<tag>"`. This is the foundation the `M3e-html` package exposes; every rich `M3e.<Component>` imports its producer here and re-exposes it under a tightened signature. Depends only on the IR substrate — no component module is imported.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

API

Constructor

type Element

The typed IR element every constructor here produces. Re-exported so callers never import HtmlIr.Element directly.

type Attr

A typed attribute. Re-exported so callers never import HtmlIr.Attribute directly.

type Node

The untyped IR node an Element wraps — the erased form, carrying no phantom claims. Re-exported for the boundaries that must store renderable content in a monomorphic field (a framework View record, a cache); lift it back with <Lib>.Unsafe.fromNode.

toHtml : M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg -> Html.Html msg

Render any element from this library to elm/html.

toNode : M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg -> M3e.Html.Node msg

Erase an element to its untyped Node — the safe out-bound direction; the phantom rows are discarded, never re-asserted.

mapMsg : (a -> b) -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy a -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy b

Map the msg type of any element from this library (the typed IR's Html.map). Structural: the tree is not rendered, rows are preserved.

mapNode : (a -> b) -> M3e.Html.Node a -> M3e.Html.Node b

mapMsg for an erased Node.

key : String.String -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg

Attach a diff key to a child so its parent container renders as a keyed node. State and animations survive reorders, insertions, and removals. Phantom rows are preserved — a keyed chip is still a chip.

lazy : (a -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg) -> a -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg

Memoise a subtree while its input is referentially unchanged. The result keeps its phantom rows and drops into any slot. The view function must be a stable top-level binding — an inline lambda allocates a fresh closure each render and silently never memoises.

lazy2 : (a -> b -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg) -> a -> b -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg

2-argument variant of lazy.

lazy3 : (a -> b -> c -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg) -> a -> b -> c -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg

3-argument variant of lazy.

lazy4 : (a -> b -> c -> d -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg) -> a -> b -> c -> d -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg

4-argument variant of lazy.

lazy5 : (a -> b -> c -> d -> e -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg) -> a -> b -> c -> d -> e -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg

5-argument variant of lazy.

lazy6 : (a -> b -> c -> d -> e -> g -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg) -> a -> b -> c -> d -> e -> g -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg

6-argument variant of lazy. Note type params skip f to match the underlying VirtualDom.lazy6 convention.

lazy7 : (a -> b -> c -> d -> e -> g -> h -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg) -> a -> b -> c -> d -> e -> g -> h -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg

7-argument variant of lazy.

lazy8 : (a -> b -> c -> d -> e -> g -> h -> i -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg) -> a -> b -> c -> d -> e -> g -> h -> i -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg

8-argument variant of lazy. This variant does not memoise — the Element→Html bridge only has room for seven memoised data arguments, so the eighth forces a fresh closure each render and defeats the reference check. For real memoisation, fold the extra state into one of the first seven arguments and use lazy7.

addClass : String.String -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg

Add a CSS class, participating in the class merge. Phantom rows preserved.

attrIf : Basics.Bool -> M3e.Html.Attr capability msg -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg

Conditionally attach an attribute — applied when the flag is True, a no-op when False. Phantom rows preserved.

when : Basics.Bool -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg

Keep an element only when the flag is True; False collapses it to an empty node that renders nothing. Phantom rows preserved.

testId : String.String -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg -> M3e.Html.Element accepts admittedBy msg
